Package index

Environment setup

kit_loadout()
Build the devgru environment by installing/loading packages
chrompar()
Scaffold function around easypar to run workflows in parallel by chromosome

Readers

read_bed_file()
Read in a BED file and convert to GenomicRanges or data.table
read_bedpe_file()
Read BEDPE File with Flexible Output Format
read_gtf_file()
Read in a GTF file and convert to GenomicRanges or data.table
read_maf_file()
Read MAF file and convert to GenomicRanges or data.table
read_vcf_file()
Read in a VCF file and convert to GenomicRanges or data.table

Conversions

dt_to_gr()
Convert data.table to GenomicRanges Object
dt_to_gi()
Convert BEDPE-like data.table to GInteractions
gi_to_dt()
Convert GInteractions to BEDPE data.table format
gi_to_grl()
Convert GInteractions to GRangesList
grl_to_gi()
Convert GenomicRangesList to GInteractions
gr_to_seg()
Convert segmentation GenomicRanges object to a data.table with standardized columns and format

GenomicRanges utilities

gr_flank()
Precise addition of flanking to GenomicRanges with boundary-aware options
gr_sanitycheck()
Check if input is a GenomicRanges object, plus optional sanity check of column names
dt_sanitycheck()
Check if input is a data.table object, plus optional sanity check of column names
gi_refactor_seqs()
Refactor seqinfo of GInteractions object for easy harmony
gr_refactor_seqs()
Refactor seqinfo, seqnames, seqlengths, seqlevels of GenomicRanges object for easy harmony
grl_refactor_seqs()
Refactor seqinfo of GRangesList object for easy harmony
aggregate_these()
Read and aggregate genomic or non-genomic data files with smart format detection

Analysis

get_cbs_per_chromosome()
Single chromosome run circular binary segmentation (CBS) algorithm on read depth profile
get_corrected_cnv_profile()
Read in CNV profile data.table of various flavors and extract a corrected profile
get_cov_gap_imputation()
Generate gap imputed coverage from fragCounter output
get_deseq2_diff_expr()
Run DESeq2 differential expression analysis on RNA-seq count data
get_fgsea_pathway_enrichment()
Run fgsea gene set enrichment analysis on DESeq2 differential gene expression output
get_fragcounter_segmentation()
Generate a segmentation file from a fragCounter read depth profile
get_igh_trx_subtype()
Detect Canonical IGH Translocations in Multiple Myeloma
get_imputed_gaps_per_chromosome()
Single chromosome run imputation of small, NA read gaps in fragCounter coverage
get_jabba_qc_diagnostic()
Run diagnostic workflow of after JaBbA run to help evaluate quality of graph
get_maf_lite()
Convert SNV & InDel mutation table to MAF-lite format
get_maf_nonsynonymous()
Extract Non-Synonymous Mutations from MAF
get_protein_coding_genes()
Extract protein-coding genes from GTF file
get_qc_diagnostics_alignment()
Generate diagnostic plots for alignment QC checks using Alfred summary files
get_qc_diagnostics_snvindel()
Generate diagnostic plots for SNV & InDel variant calling QC checks
get_vaf()
Quick pull or explicitly calculate the VAF for mutation records of various flavors

Plotting

geom_deseq2_volcano()
Volcano plot for exploring results from DESeq2 differential gene expression analysis
geom_gap_imputation()
Diagnostic plot used for reviewing the imputation of gaps in coverage profile
geom_gsea_enrichment()
Enrichment plot for exploring results from fgsea pathway enrichment analysis
geom_jabba_stats()
Diagnostic plot used for evaluating the performance of a JaBbA run
copynumber_palettier()
Create color palette for integer copy number states

CLI helpers

cli_pio_colorscheme()
Set the color scheme options for pio CLI text in devgru
cli_stopwatch_end()
Verbose CLI output to designate a workflow end
cli_stopwatch_start()
Verbose CLI output to designate a workflow start
function_cli_intro()
Verbose CLI output for extended and rich description of steps along a complex workflow, typically used in a pipeline
